Create one production concept image for the Career World skill building "VMware". This is a compact supporting skill structure: highly detailed and distinctive, smaller than project landmarks and much smaller than city capitals. Research-grounded domain summary: A virtual infrastructure capability in which ESXi abstracts physical compute, memory, storage, and devices into managed virtual machines, while vCenter organizes lifecycle, resource pools, placement, snapshots, migration, and shared capacity. Accepted baseline identity: Two stacked offset machine floors float visually above one heavy shared physical base, tied by an exposed side core and a recessed service court.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Instrument: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: virtual machines over physical substrate. Do not use VMware logos, product UI, literal server racks, nested squares copied from branding, or hardware diagrams. Preserve the abstract virtual-over-physical relationship.

One isolated complete asset in exact orthographic 2.5D isometric perspective, viewed from above at a consistent three-quarter angle. Grayscale only: neutral black, white, and gray with no color tint. Dark near-black technical drafting background with a faint isometric grid. Restrained architectural wireframe line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine parallel construction lines, controlled dense detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, before/after, or detached props. Center the whole coherent structure with generous margin. All roofs, stairs, bridges, annexes, and masses must be buildable and physically connected. No words, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand marks, UI, charts, arrows, people, vehicles, landscapes, photorealism, fantasy, or real-world facility resemblance.
